notes:
Patch 0.1.14 (auto-patch)

Players already on 0.1.13 can take this update in-game: the menu checks the patch list, downloads a direct zip (or zip parts), then applies after a short countdown you can cancel. Mega is still for first-time installs and anyone below 0.1.13.

Creatures and NPCs
- Shared relationship table: Attack, Flee, Ally, or Ignore between factions (Compact, Bandit, Livestock, ApexPredator, Hellhound, RuinWarden, Aquatic, Spirit, Troll, Mammoth, CoastalScavenger, Player).
- Bandits and wolves press livestock; yards and villagers flee them.
- Crocodiles and other water hunters take Compact folk and livestock near the bank; those flee the water.
- Trolls and mammoths keep their war; hellhounds press mammoths and ignore village yards.
- Crabs flee larger hunters. Spirits stay ignore-unless-provoked. Same-faction stays ally.

Updates
- Auto-download works when the public patch list has a direct http(s) zip URL (or zip parts under 2 GB each for GitHub Releases). Mega links still open the website Download button instead of quitting into PowerShell.

Still from 0.1.13
- Held items stay visible (LOD strip on hand props).
- Friends gamertag typing no longer leaks into gameplay; Esc closes Friends and Chat.
- Thinner, farther trees; leaves in fog; roof stops rain and muffles sound.
- Rare lightning hits on buildings; wood fire spreads when dry; rain puts it out.
